answer:
Each identity anchors to one company: one number, one identity. A reef gives each coral footing; duplicates are rejected, so each extra needs another.

A new company costs $250, 5 days, plus a 150 POA bond lost if struck off. Cheapest: a shelf company for $800 or a bribed registrar; a plume of paperwork trails them; bribed entries are audited and burned.

The anchor cannot be copied: one registry, so no number is shown twice, and shared owners get reviewed. Renting one needs a director's signature. Each fake bears a pigment stain; 100 fakes cost $25,000, 15,000 POA and 500 days.
